title: pm: the notify:security mailbox key still routes a private repository's security card (OWNER/REPO#N) to security#1 after #31301
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

Filing gate: ① the code half of a rule changed in text, found outside a claim. This is an out-of-surface hit from the #31301 card thread (os-dev report 6719528520, PR #31457), carried by the `domain:skills#2` seat.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`scripts/pm`), next from `pm:queue` after triage grades it.
Dedupe: searched "notify:security OWNER/REPO" and "record-recognisers security private" across open and closed issues: no card.

## What is wrong

PR #31457 (#31301, the maintainer's ruling quoted on that card) rewrites the protocol text:
- `security#1` owns only the public repository's advisories.
- A private repository's `security` card belongs to that repository's own lane.
- `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 now reads 「持发现席→`security#1`:公告建成或误公开卡挂标即 `Notify: security`,只带编号;私有仓卡不敲」.

The code half still says the opposite. In `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` on `main` (about L1309), the `notify:security` row of `MAILBOX_KEYS` has these two fields:
- `when`: "or the finding is on a PRIVATE repository and the seat filed an ordinary `security` issue there: that card as `OWNER/REPO#N` ALONE"
- `template`: `Notify: security · GHSA-ID or OWNER/REPO#N or #n`

`--self-test` pins the private ring as readable (about L2926, "`Notify: security · OWNER/REPO#N` — a private repository's ordinary `security` issue — reads the repository AND the card"). So `--mailbox-keys` still prints a doorbell the rule no longer has, and a seat reading the table would ring `security#1` for a cloud card.

## Ask

Once PR #31457 lands, narrow the `notify:security` row to the ruled routing:
- `when` and `template`: drop the private-repository branch.
- Reader: decide whether `readMailboxLine` keeps reading `OWNER/REPO#N` under `notify:security`. If it does, a stray ring is still parsed instead of being reported unreadable. If it does not, flip that self-test case to unreadable and keep the malformed-qualifier cases.

Add or flip one self-test case and run one ablation. Tooling only, `skip-changeset`. Do not edit the protocol text: #31457 owns it.

Blocked-by: #31301
